name: borrow
trans: v. get temporarily; take up and practice as one's own

name: lend
trans: v. bestow a quality on; give temporarily; let have for a limited time

name: return
trans: v. go or come back to place, condition, or activity where one has been before; give back

name: book
trans: v. engage for a performance; arrange for and reserve (something for someone else) in advance

name: reserve
trans: v. hold back or set aside, especially for future use or contingency; give or assign a resource to a particular person or cause

name: consultation
trans: n. a conference (usually with someone important); a conference between two or more people to consider a particular question

name: library card
trans: n. a card certifying the bearer's right to use the library

name: admission
trans: n. the act of admitting someone to enter; an acknowledgment of the truth of something

name: counter
trans: n. table consisting of a horizontal surface over which business is transacted

name: shelf
trans: n. a support that consists of a horizontal surface for holding objects

name: staff
trans: n. personnel who assist their superior in carrying out an assigned task; a strong rod or stick with a specialized utilitarian purpose

name: librarian
trans: n. a professional person trained in library science and engaged in library services

name: catalog(ue)
trans: n. 目录

name: category
trans: n. a collection of things sharing a common attribute; a general concept that marks divisions or coordinations in a conceptual scheme

name: classification
trans: n. the act of distributing things into classes or categories of the same type; a group of people or things arranged by class or category

name: call slip
trans: n. 借书单

name: title
trans: n. a heading that names a statute or legislative bill; may give a brief summary of the matters it deals with…

name: author
trans: n. writes (books or stories or articles or the like) professionally (for pay); someone who originates or causes or initiates something

name: index
trans: n. a numerical scale used to compare variables with one another or with some reference number

name: deadline
trans: n. the point in time at which something must be completed

name: expire
trans: v. lose validity; pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life

name: expiry
trans: n. a coming to an end of a contract period

name: recall
trans: v. recall knowledge from memory; have a recollection; go back to something earlier

name: renew
trans: v. reestablish on a new, usually improved, basis or make new or like new; cause to appear in a new form

name: renewal
trans: n. the conversion of wasteland into land suitable for use of habitation or cultivation; the act of renewing

name: due
trans: adj. owed and payable immediately or on demand; scheduled to arrive

name: overdue
trans: adj. past due; not paid at the scheduled time

name: fine
trans: v. issue a ticket or a fine to as a penalty
n. money extracted as a penalty

name: available
trans: adj. obtainable or accessible and ready for use or service

name: circulation
trans: n. the dissemination of copies of periodicals (as newspapers or magazines)

name: stock
trans: n. the capital raised by a corporation through the issue of shares entitling holders to an ownership interest (equity); the merchandise that a shop has on hand

name: loan
trans: v. give temporarily; let have for a limited time
n. the temporary provision of money (usually at interest)

name: inter library service
trans: n. 馆际服务
